name: Dr. W. H. Williamson
bio: Dr. W. H. Williamson, a Bismarck dentist, announced a week of dental work at Medora's Northern Pacific hotel beginning April 10, 1886, at Howard Eaton's request. In May 1886 the Cow Boy denounced a Bismarck telegram claiming that revolvers were fired all night at a cowboy ball in the hotel and that his door was riddled; the paper said a single shot had been fired in the hall outside his room and blamed him for carrying a highly colored account to Bismarck.
